ai_worker_readonly.description: Delegate a task to AI-Worker. Include the main agent's goal, findings, constraints and relevant project-relative paths in the subtask prompt. Also supports readiness and prompt-only on-device inference.
ai_worker_readonly.prompt: Use ai_worker_readonly_run_agent_task to delegate bounded work to AI-Worker. Include the parent goal, findings, constraints, relevant project-relative paths, and available handoff summary in handoffContext; omit secrets and unrelated conversation. For workspace tasks request the workspace capability. If you provide workspaceRoot, use the active project/worktree root; the MCP bridge also defaults this to OpenCode's active working directory. Include sourceAgent and workingDirectory when known. In AI-Worker local-only mode, valid workspace reads and searches run without an initial scope prompt; the exact answer is reviewed before it returns here. File writes require approval and staged-content review. Web and connected-service access require Connected mode and explicit task scope. The OpenCode host model may be remote. Use get_runtime_status for app and model readiness, and ask_local for prompt-only on-device inference without files, history, or tools.
